sections.html: Small specimens of Leporacanthicus triactis (L91), only 3-4 cm long, were recently imported from Venezuela.

Among the imported fish are an unusually large number (approx. 10) of unusually beautifully drawn variants. Normally small L91 do not look much different than the adults, only a little lighter in basic tone. But the colour variations are really a show in bright orange and black. Such colour variations of L. triactis have been known for a long time, but are only rarely available and therefore highly sought after.
